params.description: The search term to query the knowledge base. If omitted, the most recent pages are returned.

items.docs: Search for pages in the Tettra knowledge base. Results are ranked by page title matches, header matches (H1–H3), and page content. Returns up to 5 results. Omitting the query parameter returns the most recent pages.

items.docs: Publish a new question to the Tettra knowledge base. The API key determines the asker of the question. Questions can optionally be assigned to specific users and organized under a category or subcategory.
